jobs.title: Growth Director | AI-focused Agency | Hybrid in London, ON | $110-130k + benefits
jobs.description:
The Company

My client is a well-established, award-winning digital consultancy and marketing agency that partners with ambitious organizations to drive measurable business growth. Combining strategic expertise with modern marketing, technology, analytics, and AI-driven solutions, this innovative firm helps clients navigate an evolving digital landscape while delivering meaningful outcomes. With a collaborative culture, a strong reputation, and a commitment to continuous innovation, the organization is positioned at the forefront of the industry's next chapter.

The Role

They are looking for a Director of Growth to lead strategic growth initiatives for a portfolio of enterprise-level accounts while managing and developing a high-performing team of marketing professionals. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced growth marketer who thrives at the intersection of strategy, client partnership, commercial leadership, and team development.
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, owning growth strategies across channels including paid media, SEO, AI-driven search, lifecycle marketing, and CRM. Working closely with executive leadership, they will be responsible for delivering measurable results, expanding client relationships, and helping shape the agency's future direction.

Responsibilities:

Lead growth strategy and execution for a portfolio of enterprise clients
Own senior client relationships, reporting, and strategic recommendations
Develop and oversee full-funnel marketing programs across multiple channels
Manage account growth, renewals, budgets, and new business opportunities
Build statements of work and support commercial planning initiatives
Coach and mentor a team of marketers, strategists, and creatives
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and process improvements across accounts
Oversee CRM strategy, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance measurement
Contribute thought leadership through content, industry insights, and market perspectives
Collaborate with senior leadership on hiring, team development, and growth objectives

Requirements:

8+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or agency leadership roles
Proven success leading enterprise client accounts and delivering measurable business growth
Strong experience with B2B lead generation and e-commerce marketing
Deep understanding of paid media, SEO, AI search, lifecycle marketing, and CRM platforms
Hands-on experience with marketing automation and AI-driven workflows
Demonstrated people leadership and team development capabilities
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets, renewals, and account expansion
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, GA4, Looker Studio, or similar technologies
Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution

jobs.title: Director, Product Automation
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Automation based in Canada.

The Director, Product Automation will lead the development and implementation of an organization-wide AI and automation strategy, transforming how services are delivered and how clients experience technology-enabled solutions. This founding leadership role offers the opportunity to build a new function from the ground up and establish a scalable approach to product innovation. You will identify and implement technologies that improve community management, social media strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening while maintaining high standards of quality and client service. Working closely with operations, product marketing, growth, and executive leadership, you will connect internal innovation with compelling market positioning. The role combines strategic vision, practical experimentation, and cross-functional influence to deliver measurable improvements in service quality, efficiency, and scalability. You will also help shape a clear vision for combining AI capabilities with human expertise in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Accountabilities

Define and lead the organization's AI and automation strategy across products, workflows, and client service delivery.
Evaluate, test, and implement tools and technologies that improve the speed, precision, quality, and scalability of core services, including community management, social media strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening.
Develop a standardized automation framework that can be applied consistently across service offerings rather than relying on isolated, client-specific solutions.
Establish reporting infrastructure and performance metrics to measure automation's impact on operational efficiency, service quality, and margins across the technology ecosystem.
Apply a product-led approach to automation by designing, piloting, evaluating, and continuously improving capabilities based on measurable outcomes and client needs.
Collaborate with operations, product marketing, growth, and marketing teams to translate internal AI and automation capabilities into clear go-to-market strategies and messaging.
Partner with service delivery, operations, and client success teams to ensure new tools and workflows are effectively adopted and integrated into everyday work.
Represent AI and automation strategy at the leadership level, contributing to business priorities and competitive positioning as client expectations and industry technologies evolve.
Develop and communicate a company-wide vision for combining AI-enabled capabilities with human expertise, both internally and externally.
Mentor colleagues and influence teams across the organization to strengthen automation literacy, encourage experimentation, and build confidence in emerging technologies.

Requirements

Proven experience building or scaling a product, automation, AI, or technology strategy function, ideally within a services, agency, marketing technology, or related environment.
Demonstrated success translating AI or automation initiatives from initial concept into measurable operational improvements.
Strong cross-functional leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to align marketing, service delivery, operations, and executive stakeholders around shared goals.
Familiarity with social media platforms, community management, social listening, or related digital marketing technologies is a strong asset.
Experience working with enterprise marketing technology platforms, particularly where reporting or data limitations require creative solutions, alternative workflows, or additional systems.
A product innovation mindset, with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and connect their practical value to client experience and business outcomes.
Ability to establish structure, processes, and strategic direction while building a new function in an evolving environment.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain complex technical capabilities in clear, compelling business terms.
Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach to experimentation, implementation, and continuous improvement.
Confidence influencing teams and senior leaders without initially relying on a large direct-report organization.

Benefits

Salary: Annual salary range of USD $110,000–$135,000. Actual compensation may vary based on location, relevant experience, knowledge, and skills.
Employment type: Full-time, permanent position.
Flexible work arrangements: Remote designation may be available depending on the role, location, and business needs.
Collaborative work environment: Opportunities to work across teams and functions, with in-person collaboration where required by business needs.
Leadership impact: Opportunity to establish and shape a new AI and automation function and influence organization-wide strategy.
Professional growth: Exposure to emerging technologies, product innovation, strategic leadership, and cross-functional initiatives.
Innovation-focused culture: Opportunity to experiment with new tools and approaches while helping evolve digital and social media services.
Inclusive workplace: Commitment to equal employment opportunities and reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart is building a new, distinctive pillar of the Instacart Platform — an emerging portfolio of AI-driven retailer solutions — and the go-to-market infrastructure to scale it is being built right now. The opportunity is real, but translating it into scalable commercialization frameworks, pricing strategies, and GTM plans requires specialized expertise and a dedicated strategy and planning leader. We're hiring a Director of AI Solutions Strategy & Planning to lead that work end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise strategy and frontier AI, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to shape how Instacart becomes the preferred technology partner for grocery retailers.

What You'll Cook Up In Your First Year

A comprehensive GTM strategy for Instacart's AI-driven solutions is defined and in motion — spanning consumer experiences, ecommerce analytics, and enhanced retailer workflows — with clear positioning, pricing frameworks, and retailer onboarding playbooks in place.
Cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal is established, with governance forums running smoothly and transparent decision-making processes embedded across GTM and product teams.
Pilot programs and experimentation frameworks are launched and producing real impact — validating AI-powered products with real retailer feedback and iterating based on measurable performance metrics.
Sales teams are enabled and equipped with AI-specific strategies, enablement materials, and training programs that accelerate adoption and pipeline velocity.
Market intelligence and competitive analysis are regularly informing product and commercialization decisions, keeping Instacart's AI solutions competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving retailer needs.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have Pantry Staples (Minimum Qualifications)

8+ years of experience in strategy, product commercialization, or GTM planning, with a proven track record of defining and executing strategies for emerging offerings and driving measurable market impact.
Experience developing GTM strategies for AI-powered products, retailer solutions, or enterprise technology platforms.
Deep understanding of AI technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.
Expertise in product positioning, pricing frameworks, and solution packaging.
Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with modeling, forecasting, and evaluating solution performance.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a track record of influencing stakeholders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for simplifying complex concepts and presenting to internal and external audiences.
Strong quantitative skills to help inform opportunity sizing, impact assessment, pricing strategy, and financial outlook in partnership with cross-functional peers.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments, with a focus on iterative learning and innovation.

Optional Garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

Familiarity with conversational AI, ecommerce analytics, or retail technology applications.
Advanced knowledge of AI product monetization models, including subscription, usage-based, and value-based models.
MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CAN

$234,000—$247,000 CAD
